title: Chapter 399 The Defense Of The Great Steel Wall Ends
content:
Chapter 399 The Defense Of The Great Steel Wall Ends

A system prompt sounded in Wang Shuo's mind.

[You killed the demon beast leader Apache. ]

[The defense of the Iron Great Wall is over. ]

[You obtained 10 promotion pills and the production drawings of golden wall bricks. ]

[The trial of the Shura Warrior Tower is over, and you have obtained the title of "Red Eyed Shura". ]

[You have obtained the production drawings of the Shura suit. ]

At this moment, the war started again. Wang Shuo put away the items and took out the demon pill from Apache's head.

Seeing that the demon pill was crystal clear, Wang Shuo suddenly had a bold idea.

If he took this demon pill with huge energy and a promotion pill, would he be able to break through and advance?

Wang Shuo made up his mind. Now that Zhao Bangde was injured, Zhu Dongheng might not be able to stop the Black Dragon King.

He immediately retreated a distance and found a relatively safe place, and asked Ye Tianba to guard beside him.

He took out the demon pill and the promotion pill and put them in his mouth.

A long-lost familiar feeling!

A stream of pure energy turned into internal force, flowing through his limbs and bones.

He immediately operated his skills, guided his internal force, and hit the bottleneck.

Wang Shuo's breakthrough to the intermediate general made a huge noise.

It was noticed by the Black Dragon King on the battlefield in the distance.

"You actually want to break through on the battlefield, what a wishful thinking."

The Black Dragon King immediately exhaled a breath of death, transformed into a small black dragon, and pounced on Wang Shuo, trying to interrupt his breakthrough.

Zhu Dongheng's pupils suddenly shrank, and he immediately sent a puppet to block the small black dragon.

The puppet and the small black dragon collided in mid-air, and a shocking explosion occurred.

The puppet was directly destroyed and died together with the small black dragon.

"Black Dragon King, your opponent is me, so don't be distracted to deal with a junior."

"Humph, just you? You are not my opponent!"

The Black Dragon King's strength is gradually recovering at this time, and he has reached the peak combat power of the intermediate general.

If Zhu Dongheng had not relied on the large number of puppets, he would have been defeated.

Although Zhu Dongheng was at a disadvantage, he did not panic.

In the past few months, the number of primary warriors on the human side has increased by several.

So they can barely resist the attack of the undead.

Not long after, all of Zhu Dongheng's puppets were dismantled by the Black Dragon King and he was about to be defeated.

Wang Shuo let out a long roar and finally broke through to the intermediate warrior.

Both "Black Dragon Sutra" and "Dragon Spear Tactics" broke through to the fifth level, and also comprehended a skill "Flying Dragon in the Sky".

At this moment, Wang Shuo also activated the "Multiplication Technique" skill, directly raising his own aura to the level of a high-level warrior.

In this way, the deterrence to the Black Dragon King can be greatly improved.

Just at this time, a general came over and handed Wang Shuo a set of equipment.

"Lord Wang, this is sent by Zhao Junshou, who said it can help you!"

Wang Shuo looked at the spear and armor sent, and couldn't help but feel a little happy.

"Zhao Jun Shou wakes up?" Wang Shuo smiled. Zhao Bangde was like a magic needle that stabilizes the sea. As long as he was there, everything seemed to be solved.

"Zhao Jun Shou ordered that Lord Wang just fight."

Wang Shuo was relieved.

What Zhao Bangde sent over was a set of epic equipment.

[Overlord Spear: Epic equipment, strength +500, constitution +300, attack power +2000, with passive skill heavy attack. ]

Holding it in his hand, Wang Shuo felt the heaviness of the Overlord Spear, and the power surged. He felt that he couldn't wait to have a big fight.

After putting on armor and other equipment, Wang Shuo went straight to the Black Dragon King.

When he looked at the Black Dragon King now, he didn't feel the fear he had before.

The Black Dragon King was just a powerful boss!
